title: National and State Regulatory Frameworks, ZLD Mandates, and Statutory Compliance Standards

data.Regulation Name: CPCB Comprehensive Environmental Pollution Index (CEPI) & ZLD Directives
data.Applicable Industry: Textile Wet Processing, Dyeing & Bleaching Units
data.Compliance Requirements: Mandatory installation of Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD) systems for units discharging > 25 KLD in Ganga & Cauvery river basins.
data.Discharge Standards: Zero Liquid Discharge (0.0 KLD liquid discharge outside unit premises)
data.Water Reuse Standards: RO Permeate TDS < 100 mg/L (100% recycled back into dye house process)
data.Reporting Requirements: Real-time Online Continuous Effluent Monitoring System (OCEMS) data streaming to CPCB server

data.Regulation Name: Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act 1974 & Consent to Operate (CTO)
data.Regulatory Authority: State Pollution Control Board (SPCB / TNPCB / GPCB)
data.Applicable Industry: All Textile Processing and Finishing Mills
data.Compliance Requirements: Valid Consent to Establish (CTE) & Consent to Operate (CTO); compliance with flow meters and logbook records.
data.Discharge Standards: BOD ≤ 30 mg/L, COD ≤ 250 mg/L, TSS ≤ 100 mg/L, pH 6.5 - 8.5
data.Water Reuse Standards: Specific water consumption ≤ 80 L/kg fabric processed
data.Reporting Requirements: Monthly Environmental Audit Report & Annual Environmental Statement (Form V)

data.Regulation Name: Hazardous and Other Wastes (Management and Transboundary Movement) Rules 2016
data.Regulatory Authority: MoEFCC & SPCB Hazardous Waste Management Cell
data.Compliance Requirements: Safe storage, manifest tracking, and disposal of ETP chemical sludge & MEE dry salts at authorized TSDF facilities.
data.Discharge Standards: Sludge Leachate heavy metal content within Schedule II TCLP limits
data.Reporting Requirements: Annual Hazardous Waste Return (Form 4) & Manifest Form 10

data.Regulation Name: Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) for Issuance of ZLD Certificates
data.Applicable Industry: Textile Clusters (Tirupur, Surat, Ludhiana, Pali, Ahmedabad)
data.Compliance Requirements: Installation of magnetic flow meters on raw water intake, RO permeate line, MEE condensate line, and reject stream.
data.Discharge Standards: Absolute Zero Discharge into storm drains or inland water bodies
data.Reporting Requirements: Electromagnetic Flowmeter telemetry logged every 15 minutes to SPCB portal
